refuted.claim: Gross margin a pharmacy would earn: Rs 2.66 L/yr
refuted.why: Unfalsifiable as published, and it is the number the entire verdict turns on. No revenue base, no margin %, no SKU count and no demand proxy is given here or in [[Verify-Pass-2026-08-30]], which carries the identical figure with no derivation either — so 'the sizer's figure, carried forward' resolves to nothing. The note's own §'What this does NOT show' says demand 'is not measured and cannot be' in FR8HODBNEW, which means the vault cannot support Rs 2.66 L any more than it can refute it. The ESTIMATED tag is honest but insufficient: an unsourced number in a table of otherwise rupee-exact VERIFIED rows reads as measured.

The arithmetic is correct (2.66 − 3.00 and 2.66 − 2.16), but it is arithmetic on two outside estimates, one of which (above) has no derivation at all. If Rs 2.66 L is out by a factor of two in either direction the sign of the contribution flips and the recommendation inverts, so the band carries no more information than the estimate under it. Inherits the refutation above.
